confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings; July 2026 values are projected, not observed. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by area and room type. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from the beer anchor (about 2x and 2.5x) because direct bar and by-the-glass knowledge is weak. FX value and date come from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read; snapshot timing is unconfirmed and the search output carried an unrelated formatting instruction that I ignored, so check the live RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to other mid-sized Northern Thai tourism cities such as Chiang Rai, priced below Bangkok's central tourist districts, with accommodation adjusted for July rainy-season (low-season) demand.
